title: I work the front desk of a hotel that is always full. Room 214 has been booked every night this month.
transcript:
I work the front desk of a hotel that is always full. Room 214 has been booked every night this month. My shift starts at 11 PM. Management gave me one binder and one instruction. Never send anyone to 214.

I figured it was a plumbing issue. Then the booking screen showed 214 occupied again. Guest name blank. Paid in full.

At 2:10 AM the elevator opened on the lobby with nobody inside. It rang for the second floor.

I checked the cameras. The hallway outside 214 was empty, but the door handle was moving. Slowly down, then up. Like someone testing it.

Then the desk phone lit up. Extension 214. I let it ring, because the cameras showed nobody in the room. It stopped, and started again, over and over.

I answered at last. A calm voice said, Could you send up more towels? We're a little crowded in here.

I looked at the binder. Page nine, in the margin, in pen. Count the keycards at the end of the night.

I counted. We keep forty cards on the board. There were forty-one.

The extra one was warm, like it had just been held.

The label on it said, Front Desk.
